answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with staked capital rather than node count. An attacker seeking to flood the garden of digital agents with fake identities must incur the substantial cost of acquiring and locking sufficient assets to command network weight. Any deviation from protocol rules results in a plume of slashing events, causing an umber loss of principal. This economic barrier ensures that identity multiplication remains prohibitively expensive.
